name: resctl
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @github/copilot @anthropic-ai/claude-code && sudo ln -sf $(npm prefix -g)/bin/copilot /usr/local/bin/copilot && sudo ln -sf $(npm prefix -g)/bin/claude /usr/local/bin/claude && go install github.com/josephspurrier/goversioninfo/cmd/goversioninfo@latest && curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin
